scenarios.name: ellipse-07 Create and undo a rotated ellipse

scenario_steps.name: a copy of `fixtures/cad/ellipse/empty-yz.opd` is open with Sketch1 being edited in RIGHT view
the fixture center is (20, -20) mm, first-axis point is (27, -17) mm and point on the ellipse is (18.8, -17.2) mm in sketch coordinates
the editable recorded fixture has clear canvas for a rotated ellipse
the user select the fixture center
the user select the fixture first-axis point
the user select the fixture point on the ellipse
a tilted closed oval appears and the command requests another center
